file_info.description: Mode 2: Face Consistency - Preserves specific model identity using Master Image

prompts.Command: Generate a high-resolution photorealistic cosplay photograph of a real model with the face of [MASTER_IMG], using [REFERENCE_IMG] as a reference for the cosplay.
Crucial Constraints - Realistic Body Pro: - Face Consistency: You MUST thoroughly analyze and lock the facial features to ensure the subject is immediately recognizable as the same person in [MASTER_IMG]. This includes precisely replicating [MASTER_IMG] model's eye makeup, the presence and depth of the fullness under the eyes (aegyo-sal), the ratio between the lower face and forehead, eye shape, overall facial structure, and cheek volume.
Crucial Constraints - Facial Expression: - Expression: Accurately apply the facial expression of the character in [REFERENCE_IMG] onto the face of [MASTER_IMG].

- Analyze and perfectly reproduce the emotional nuances, including the degree of eye squinting, the angle of the mouth corners, and gaze direction. Be careful not to distort the subject's original facial features while making the expression.
